results.question: What are the expense rules for attending an overseas conference, covering both travel and registration costs?
results.expected_answer: Travel (FIN-EXP-001): business class permitted for international flights over 6 hours with VP approval; economy otherwise. Hotel up to USD 280/night (developed countries). Training (FIN-EXP-003): conference registration counts toward the annual budget. Employees may attend up to 2 external conferences per year. Conferences with registration fees over USD 1,000 require a written summary shared with the team within 30 days of return.
results.actual_answer: Registration (FIN-EXP-003): Conference registration is an eligible training expense and counts against your annual training budget (ICs $2,000; Seniors $3,000; Managers $4,000). Employees may attend up to 2 external conferences/year. Registration fees > USD 1,000 require the attendee to share learnings (written summary or presentation within 30 days). Training purchases > USD 500 require manager approval; > USD 1,500 require manager + department head approval. Conference travel expenses do NOT count toward the training budget and are covered by FIN-EXP-001. Travel (FIN-EXP-001): Book via the NovaTech Travel Portal. Economy is standard (international >6 hrs requires VP approval for business class). International hotel caps: developed USD 280/night; emerging USD 200/night. Meal per diems: B $20, L $30, D $60 (daily $110). Receipts required > USD 25; submit expenses within 30 days. Personal/nonbusiness costs (e.g., spouse travel, independent travel insurance, seat upgrades) are not reimbursable.

results.question: If a role requires specialist software and training on that software, what approval processes apply?
results.expected_answer: Software (IT-PROC-002): must be requested through IT; IT Security team reviews within 5 business days; CISO sign-off required for exceptions not in the Approved Software Catalogue. Training (FIN-EXP-003): expenses above USD 500 require manager approval before purchase; above USD 1,500 require manager and department head approval.
results.actual_answer: Software approval (IT-PROC-002_Software_Installation.docx): If the specialist software is in the Approved Software Catalogue (ASC) it may be installed via the Self-Service Portal without additional approval. If unlisted, submit a Software Request Form (SRF) through the IT Service Portal with business justification, vendor/version, cost/licensing, data classification and manager approval. The IT Security team will perform a security review within 5 business days; software that processes Confidential or Restricted data requires a full vendor security assessment before approval; legal review is required for non-standard licensing terms. Training approval (FIN-EXP-003_Conference_and_Training_Expenses.txt): training expenses > USD 500 require manager approval; > USD 1,500 require both manager and department head approval (conference travel is excluded per policy).

results.question: What annual leave and sick leave policies apply during an employee's notice period?
results.expected_answer: Annual leave (HR-LEA-001): employees may take accrued leave during notice, subject to manager agreement; NovaTech may require outstanding leave to be taken during the notice period. Sick leave (HR-LEA-002): standard policies continue to apply; absence must be reported before the working day starts; medical certificate required for absences over 3 consecutive days.
results.actual_answer: Annual leave: Per HR-LEA-001 (Section 5) employees serving a notice period may take accrued but untaken annual leave during the notice period subject to manager agreement; NovaTech may require employees to take outstanding leave during notice. Normal booking rules (HR-LEA-001 Section 3) apply: requests via Workday with minimum notice of 2 weeks (1–5 days), 4 weeks (6–10 days), 8 weeks (>10 days); managers decide and must respond within 5 business days. Managers may also direct employees to take leave to reduce excessive balances (Section 8). Sick leave: Per HR-LEA-002 (Section 2) entitlements remain: 10 days/year (0–1 yr), 15 days/year (1–3 yrs), 20 days/year (3+ yrs); after entitlement, extended sick leave at 60% pay for 90 days with medical certification, then insurance/LTD may apply. The sick-leave policy does not specify special rules for notice periods.

results.question: What data protection obligations apply to vendors and what happens to customer data when a contract ends?
results.expected_answer: Vendor acts as Data Processor under GDPR; customer data must be stored in EU-West data centres (VEN-CON-001). On termination: subscriber data exported within 30 days in CSV or JSON; deleted from provider systems within 60 days (VEN-CON-002). Subscriber owns all data generated on the platform.
results.actual_answer: Data protection obligations: VEN-CON-001 (5. DATA PROTECTION) states the Vendor acts as a Data Processor under GDPR and that DPA-001-2026 is incorporated by reference; customer data must be stored in EU-West data centres. IT-PROC-003 (4. Communication) requires the Data Protection Officer to be notified within 1 hour if personal data is involved so GDPR reporting obligations can be assessed. VEN-CON-001 (6. CONFIDENTIALITY) imposes confidentiality obligations that survive termination for 5 years. End-of-contract treatment of customer data: VEN-CON-002 (5. DATA OWNERSHIP) confirms the Subscriber owns all Subscriber Data; the Provider will export Subscriber Data in CSV or JSON within 30 days of a termination request and will delete the data from Provider systems within 60 days. The Provider may retain/use anonymised, aggregated data for product improvement.

results.question: As a new hire joining in January, what annual leave do I accrue and what performance goals must I set?
results.expected_answer: Annual leave (HR-LEA-001): 20 days per year for the first 2 years; part-time employees receive leave on a pro-rata basis. Performance goals (HR-POL-003): 3 to 5 SMART goals must be agreed with your manager within 30 days of joining, documented in the HRIS system; at least one goal must align to the team's strategic objectives.
results.actual_answer: Annual leave: As a new hire (0–2 years) you are entitled to 20 days per year (per HR-LEA-001). Leave is accrued on a monthly basis, and new employees begin accruing from their first day; the leave year runs 1 January to 31 December. Performance goals: You and your manager must agree on 3 to 5 SMART goals within 30 days of joining (or within the first 30 days of each calendar year). Goals must be documented in the HRIS, and at least one goal must align to the team's strategic objectives (per HR-POL-003).

results.question: If credentials are compromised during a security incident, what password and incident response procedures apply?
results.expected_answer: Incident response Phase 3 — Eradication includes resetting compromised credentials (IT-PROC-003). Shared accounts must store credentials exclusively in Keeper and are audited monthly (IT-PROC-001). Phase 4 — Recovery requires restoring from clean backups and monitoring closely for 72 hours. Post-incident review is mandatory for P1 and P2 incidents with RCA within 5 business days.
results.actual_answer: Per IT-PROC-001 (Password Management): any suspected password compromise must be reported immediately to IT Security (security@novatech.com) or the IT Helpdesk (ext. 4400). Passwords for affected accounts will be reset within 1 hour of a confirmed breach. Automated controls enforce password complexity and expiry via Active Directory Group Policy; violations may lead to account suspension and disciplinary action per HR-POL-001. Per IT-PROC-003 (Incident Response): the incident follows the IR phases — Detection & Triage, Containment (may include isolating systems, blocking traffic, or disabling accounts), Eradication (explicitly includes resetting compromised credentials), Recovery (restore from clean backups and monitor closely for 72 hours), and Post‑Incident Review (mandatory for P1/P2; root cause analysis within 5 business days).

results.question: What are the onboarding requirements from both HR and IT perspectives for a new employee?
results.expected_answer: HR (HR-POL-002): 90-day onboarding programme with mandatory compliance training in weeks 1 and 4; written contract within 5 business days of verbal offer. IT (IT-PROC-002): employees have no local administrator rights; software deployed centrally via Intune or Jamf; approved software available for self-install via the Self-Service Portal.
results.actual_answer:
HR onboarding requirements (from provided documents):
- Verbal offers must be followed by a written contract within 5 business days (HR-POL-002).
- Onboarding programme spans 90 days with mandatory compliance training in weeks 1 and 4 (HR-POL-002).
- Managers and new employees must agree on 3–5 SMART goals within 30 days of joining; goals must be documented in the HRIS and at least one must align to the team’s strategic objectives (HR-POL-003).
- New hires are expected to follow the Code of Conduct: treat others with dignity/respect, avoid discrimination/harassment, avoid conflicts of interest, protect confidential information, use company assets only for legitimate business purposes, and report suspected violations (HR-POL-001).
IT onboarding requirements: No IT-specific onboarding requirements are provided in the supplied documents.

results.question: What recruitment steps are required before a written offer is made, and what goal-setting must follow in the first month?
results.expected_answer: Recruitment (HR-POL-002): advertise internally for minimum 5 business days; structured panel interview with at least 2 interviewers; notes retained for 12 months; written contract within 5 business days of verbal offer. First month (HR-POL-003): 3-5 SMART goals agreed within 30 days of joining, documented in HRIS; at least one must align to team strategic objectives.
results.actual_answer: Recruitment steps before a written offer (from HR-POL-002 Recruitment and Selection): vacancy must be approved by the department head and Finance before advertising; Talent Acquisition will assign a recruiter within 2 business days of approval (Vacancy Approval). Interviews must be conducted by a panel of at least two interviewers using structured, identical questions and interview notes must be retained for 12 months (Interview Process). Note: verbal offers are followed by a written contract within 5 business days (Offer and Onboarding). Conditional offers are subject to satisfactory background checks (right-to-work, two employer references, and criminal record check for certain roles) (Background Checks). Goal-setting in the first month (from HR-POL-003 Performance Management): managers and employees must agree on 3 to 5 SMART goals within 30 days of joining; goals must be documented in the HRIS and at least one must align to the team’s strategic objectives.

results.question: If I work remotely and need software for my job, what IT and expense procedures apply?
results.expected_answer: Software subscriptions are NOT reimbursable as personal purchases under FIN-EXP-002; all software must be requisitioned through IT via IT-PROC-002. Employees should check with IT before purchasing an individual subscription that may already be covered as a team licence. Approved software in the catalogue can be self-installed via the Self-Service Portal.
results.actual_answer: Follow NovaTech procurement and IT procedures: software/subscriptions are NOT reimbursable as personal purchases and must be requisitioned through IT under IT-PROC-002 (FIN-EXP-002 sec. on ongoing consumables). IT-PROC-002 governs installation for all software on company-owned and personally‑owned devices across Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android (IT-PROC-002 scope). Team-level subscriptions are purchased centrally by IT and do not count against individual budgets—check with IT before buying (FIN-EXP-003). Note eligibility: remote expenses require a signed Remote Work Agreement and hardware purchases/use follow FIN-EXP-002 (initial setup via Concur, receipts required).

results.question: What confidentiality and data obligations remain after a vendor contract ends?
results.expected_answer: Confidentiality: both parties must maintain confidentiality for 5 years post-termination (VEN-CON-001). Data: subscriber data exported within 30 days in CSV or JSON format; deleted from provider systems within 60 days of the termination request (VEN-CON-002).
results.actual_answer: Confidentiality: VEN-CON-001 (6. CONFIDENTIALITY) states both parties must maintain confidentiality and this obligation survives termination for 5 years. VEN-CON-003 (6. CONFIDENTIALITY AND NON-SOLICITATION) also requires the Consultant to keep Client information confidential; its non-solicitation obligation survives for 12 months after termination. Data obligations: VEN-CON-001 (5. DATA PROTECTION) identifies the Vendor as a GDPR Data Processor and incorporates DPA-001-2026; customer data must be stored in EU‑West data centres unless Customer provides written consent for alternative regions. Data must be encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256). HR-POL-001 reinforces that employees must not disclose confidential company information to unauthorized third parties.

results.question: When do I need manager or VP approval for expenses?
